nodes.label: f_degVis (degree visible-structure judge: effective top AND bottom in window)
nodes.rationale: Replaced f_degIn (single-point existence) which was always-true due to nesting law + anchor injection + pending pushed eff=true; lesson requires plural tops AND bottoms ('ظهرت قمم وقيعان') so degree count varies and '4 => go up' becomes reachable.

nodes.label: f_impulseIn (impulse medium legs count + durations in range)
nodes.rationale: Generalized over a [fromB..toB] range on purpose: called for current wave, then historical waves if sample insufficient — one function, no dual path; reads drawn chain (mcBar) not raw, excludes pending tip (lesson06 wait rule).

nodes.label: f_drawWavePanel (wave test panel)
nodes.rationale: frameFit decided by degree COUNT not time (user ruling 2026-07-15; lesson forbids time as judge: 'ما تقدرش تحكمها بمدّة زمنيّة'); old refDays-based rule gave 'go lower TF' 19/20 = non-varying value. degShown>3 branch deliberately dormant until 4th degree exists (Fail Loud via subCapHit shown in panel).

nodes.label: f_pushChain (unified chain push: dedupe at boundary + enforce alternation)
f_lastRevBar (level-break reversal detector, wantFirst param)
nodes.rationale: Wave terminator = break of the horizontal medium level (bodies) by 2 candles (lesson09 + user ruling 2026-07-15). wantFirst=true makes the splitting loop walk forward reversal-by-reversal catching ALL of them; with last-reversal the first segment swallowed intermediate reversals and feedPivot applied effectiveness with a wrong reference. One function with a parameter — no dual path (constitution). Reads the SAME chain the chart draws (pending point included) — dual-source bug (tme confirmed-only vs drawn medLevelLine) caused rb=na => nSub==1 => no chain (measured live US100-60).

nodes.label: f_lastEffTypeI (last effective pivot of given type)
f_activeDir (latched effective direction via confirmed level breaks)
nodes.rationale: Display-only latch (lesson09/m3-a): past tops/bottoms stay fixed; direction flips only on confirmed break (2 closes behind BODY of last effective extreme). Simulates direction evolution across the wave in one islast pass.

nodes.label: f_liqBroken (sloped liquidity-line break detector, 2 closes)
nodes.rationale: Slope computed in bars not time (reverted #3 in v2.39.2) to match jwl.f_liqLine and the TradingView bar axis; no offset — matches the drawn line exactly.

nodes.label: f_atlasDecision (FSM decision table from full state)
nodes.rationale: Display-only rule-table (Atlas L2-03/04), not nested ifs; priorities: large reversal => review, out of zone => no trade, conflict => range only, agreement in zone: no target => no trade, maturity+confirm => buy/sell, else wait. Kept consistent with basicSig/hrSig signal classification (red line: signal == panel).

nodes.label: f_degree4 (MTF 4th-degree two-candle confirmation engine)
nodes.rationale: Independent pure-price two-valid-candle engine run via request.security on a smaller TF (lesson L2-04): returns [broke last valid top => buy confirm, broke last valid bottom => sell confirm]. Ported from legacy code.

nodes.label: f_covLater (O(n) covered-later precompute)
nodes.rationale: Performance P1: single reverse pass with running max-top/min-bottom replaces an O(n) loop inside every coverage call; chains are time-ascending so higher index = later bar.

nodes.label: f_coveredAt (coverage law per point, per-layer switches)
nodes.rationale: Lesson05 coverage: a point is covered if a later same-type point is more extreme => not effective. Per-layer switches covCur/covHist/covHoH; exception: outside the wave price range stays effective.

nodes.label: f_emitDegSignals (per-degree historical entry signals with gate+confirm+RR)
nodes.rationale: 'Every correction = a trade; trade degree = correction degree': effective in-zone extreme in trend direction => buy/sell; G2 gate = phase at the EXTREME (correction depth) not at the break; confirm = first CLOSED candle breaking the opposite reference (no flicker); target = next-degree zone => automatic laddering; returns funnel diagnostics [inZone, confirmed, emitted].

nodes.label: f_emitExit (exit signals: zone break + retest + rejection)
nodes.rationale: Third-opportunity pattern (v2.4): confirmed break behind zone (1 valid candle >=15m, else 2), then first closed candle touching the broken edge and closing back behind it => single exit signal, stop = opposite zone edge, target = nearest next zone.

nodes.label: leg engine state + bigDir (global hysteresis direction)
nodes.rationale: Post t2-1 only legInputs => bigDir survives from the leg engine; legStep/buildSegments deleted (dead state), wave boundaries now come from reversals not legs. bigDir's real consumers: segDir fallback, curWaveDir, conclusions.

nodes.label: wL0/wL0px/wL0top (search anchor: oldest extreme in WAVE_WIN)
nodes.rationale: f0-5 pass 1: structural extreme-to-extreme on tails within the view window — NOT 'the wave' but the start of the OLDEST wave in the chain (splitting seed). Computed once per bar in the first islast block; all readers guarded by the same islast => stale value never read ('one wave per bar' invariant).

nodes.label: curSubL/curSubPx/curSubTop (reversal-boundary chain arrays)
nodes.rationale: t2-1: THIS IS THE WHOLE CHAIN — ascending [wLb, sub1..subN]; last = current wave, before it = history, then history-of-history. curSubTop records each boundary type (top => next segment falls) and is the alternation guarantee; curSubPx never contains na ([0]=pass-1 extreme, [k]=reversal extreme).

nodes.label: segLefts/segRights/segLeftPx/segLeftTop (analysis segments, descending: 0=current wave)
nodes.rationale: Lesson03 multi-wave analysis feed; descending order (0 = newest = current wave) is what every upper layer expects. Since t2-1 built entirely from curSub* reversals (single source) — the old leg.bars path (legTh => the fabricated '21 days') was a dual path producing a broken chain. histDepth trims only display depth of history, never index 0.

nodes.label: curWdir/curWdir0/curRevB (current-segment vs whole-chain direction)
nodes.rationale: curWdir = direction of the LAST segment (buildWave(lastL,wRb)) — frame panel reference for the current wave; curWdir0 = flDir@gi=0 = direction of the WHOLE chain — kept alive as chain-direction reference for the frame panel; distinct because curWdir flips with renewal.

nodes.label: subCapHit + SUB_CAP=20 (Fail Loud truncation flag)
nodes.rationale: SUB_CAP is a runaway-loop guard, not a logic threshold; hitting it means the wave was TRUNCATED => flag raised and panel warns (no silent cut, section 11). Loop range 0..SUB_CAP (fix b8): last iteration detects-without-push so the flag fires only on a REAL cut, not on exactly-20 reversals.

nodes.label: smallDegree/mediumDegree/mediumEff/mediumBreak (main DegreeLaws instances, current wave)
nodes.rationale: mediumDegree = RAW medium (all rule-b pairs via appendEff) = drawing positions; mediumEff = after the two degree laws (sequence+effectiveness via feedPivot) => defines what is effective; what dropped out = ineffective (display). mediumBreak = break generator (effective small => raw medium).

nodes.label: mcBar/mcPrc/mcTop/mcEff/mcTm (unified medium chain across all waves)
nodes.rationale: One connected chain oldest-to-newest with strict alternation (f_pushChain) — monotonicity is assumed by large-degree feed, medLinks, coverage, zones, Elliott, signals and the panel; double-building history (fix e1) broke all of them at every reversal.

nodes.label: scBar/scPrc/scTop/scEff/scTm (unified small chain across history)
nodes.rationale: Small degree 'always present' across the whole chart, not only the current wave — mirrors the medium chain.

nodes.label: lgBar/lgPrc/lgTop/lgTm/lgEff (unified large chain, both methods)
nodes.rationale: Unified drawing positions for both large-degree methods behind useBigBreak: (break) from effective medium via feedBreakUp/Down; (leg) from wave boundaries segLefts/segLeftTop. Nesting preserved (large subset of medium) either way.

nodes.label: lgPendBg (pending large tip bar, hoisted global)
nodes.rationale: Hoisted (bActVg pattern) so f_degVis in the panel can exclude the live pending large tip (lesson06 wait rule: unconfirmed tip is not visible structure and moves every bar => counting it = repaint); source lgPendB is local to the large block.

nodes.label: bActVg/mActVg/sActVg (active-direction cache per degree)
nodes.rationale: Performance P3: f_activeDir loops the whole chart and was called ~11x with identical args (chains final after line ~1255) => computed once at islast, read by all blocks (levels, liquidity, conclusions, signals).

nodes.label: Block: leg engine setup (jwf.newLegEngine + legInputs => bigDir)
Block: wave splitting islast (v0.23.0 wave-bounded build)
nodes.rationale: Wave-bounded build at islast: incremental rolling-window build flipped direction dozens of times (leakage into previous wave) erasing effectiveness references; here bounds [wLb..wRb] are known and fixed => one direction => effectiveness/sequence work and noise drops.

nodes.label: for gi splitting loop (recursive renewal: cut at every reversal)
nodes.rationale: Each iteration: fresh tsd/tmd/tme/tmb, jwd.buildWave on [ssL..wRb], find FIRST reversal (f_lastRevBar wantFirst=true) with STRUCTURAL alternating seed sDir from curSubTop's last type — not global flDir (which made splitBar==ssL => silent break => nSub always 2 and SUB_CAP dead code); split at the segment extreme (highest high if rising / lowest low if falling), push boundary to curSub*, advance ssL. Pending point merged into the tested chain so the detector reads the same series the chart draws (single source). Remaining recorded gap: buildWave builds tme with its GLOBAL direction not sDir => effectiveness quality on opposing segments incomplete until wdir is passed as an argument (JW_Degrees change + publish).

nodes.label: Block: chain build (curSub* => segLefts, main degrees rebuild, anchor)
nodes.rationale: Builds descending segLefts/segRights/segLeftPx/segLeftTop from ascending curSub* (0=current wave; histDepth trims history display only), then rebuilds smallDegree/mediumDegree/mediumEff/mediumBreak on the LAST segment via jwd.buildWave => curWdir; anchors mediumDegree[0] on the segment extreme (curSubPx last — leg branch dropped).

nodes.label: Block: current-wave box + history boxes drawing
nodes.rationale: f0-5: the 'historical wave' box = CURRENT wave [segLefts[0]..now] (user ruling 2026-07-15); drawing on wL0 (search anchor = several waves, 500 bars) swallowed history rectangles inside it (inverted nesting) and contradicted every layer reading segLefts[0]. History boxes moved here because segLefts is built above, not in the old drawing block.

nodes.label: Block: medium/small chain build + medium circles drawing (islast)
nodes.rationale: Part (1) owns history segments (respects histDepth): per segment fresh sd/md/me/mb + jwd.buildWave, anchor both ends on segLeftPx, push via f_pushMed/f_pushSmall (eff = membership in me or pending). Part (2) owns ONLY the current segment (fix e1: the old 0..nSub-1 loop double-built history => non-monotone mcBar/scBar => everything assuming monotonicity collapsed + doubled circles ate the 500-object cap); anchor = curSubPx[si] (fix e2: segLeftPx[0] after t2-1 is the NEWEST not oldest). Pending live tip NOT pushed (wait rule d06). Part (3) draws circles with inline coverage logic (same as f_coveredAt literally).

nodes.label: Block: small degree drawing from scBar (last 90, arrows + links)
Block: large degree build + drawing + Elliott (two methods behind useBigBreak)
nodes.rationale: Method break: effective medium (mcEff) through one continuous break generator (feedBreakUp/Down => largeRaw.appendEff + largeEffD.feedPivot). Method leg (legLiveBreak): same generator but direction per containing wave from segLeftTop (segLefts descending: first boundary <= bb wins), resetting incoming-direction fields + started=false + inCorr=false at each wave boundary so the wave start is emitted (every wave start = a nested large top/bottom) with no leakage. Pending large tip flushed as a live point (#1) — else the current blue never draws (incomplete nesting); flush direction MUST stay identical to feed direction (invariant, curWaveDir expression). Elliott ewRun called small then medium then LARGE LAST so large survives Pine's oldest-label deletion at the cap.

nodes.label: Block: MTF confirmation (request.security f_degree4 on smaller TF)
nodes.rationale: User rule for the confirm TF: chart >15m => 15m, =15m => 5m, <15m => 1m; repaints on the live bar — natural intrabar behavior.

nodes.label: Block: trend level lines (horizontal on bodies, 3 degrees)
Block: liquidity lines (sloped on tails, 3 degrees, broken => dashed)
nodes.rationale: Liquidity always drawn on the active-direction side (shows slope even against the level = useful divergence); broken line is display-only dashed or hidden (lesson09: new line requires two new extremes).

nodes.label: Block: m.A levels + zones (unified pool + pairing, L2-02)
nodes.rationale: Unified pool (user ruling 2026-07-14) = effective medium (not the live pending tip) + covered history + large; large subset of medium => marked blue, not duplicated (prevents zero-height zones). Pairing any type except a top with its direct correction, no zone-inside-zone, no minimum — all in jwz.f_pairZones. m.A line of any endpoint that became a zone member is deleted (singles stay lines). Zone colored support/resistance by price side.

nodes.label: Block: conclusions/decision panel + live signal (lesson09/10 + Atlas)
nodes.rationale: Liquidity direction gate is DELIBERATELY strict (user ruling 2026-07-15, do NOT relax): defined only when BOTH large and medium liq directions exist; 'undefined' in 13/16 readings is the CORRECT display — one top cannot define a slope (m>=2 in JW_Lines). Entry = level active dir of medium+large. G2 despair gate follows trade degree (phM if medium trade else phS) — single source for decision+signal+mark type. Live signal: basicSig (maturity>=2 + confirm in zone) / hrSig (panic + confirm) / break-fallback (valid-candle zone exit, confirm = the exit candle itself); no signal without target; no new entry while large is panic/despair (review E); labels are STATIC (drawn once at bar close, never move); alert independent of mark visibility; RR gate optional (minRR).

nodes.label: Block: historical per-degree signals + exit + funnel diag table (islast)
nodes.rationale: Signal direction = LEVEL direction (medium+large, same as panel entry) not raw bigDir (they diverge after a level break); per-degree emit calls pass each degree's own coverage cache and active dir; exit signals limited to last <=500 bars (performance).

nodes.label: Block: wave test panel compute (degrees shown + impulse stats)
nodes.rationale: Counting window cntB = VIEW_WIN (what is SEEN on screen), independent of any degree — wlB=segLefts[0] is itself a product of the medium-level break so counting inside it is circular and the 4th degree could never appear ('4 => go up' unreachable); spec judges the wave/frame PAIR. Impulse stats: measure inside the current wave, fall back to historical waves oldest-first until sample >= 2 (median on 1 sample is meaningless); impHist disclosed with '(hist.)' suffix; '—' honest when no sample (no invented number). Reads drawn chain mcBar not raw mediumDegree (S1 fix: raw appendEff chain gave 1-bar legs => '35min median' inside a 4.6-day wave => inverted frame advice).
